About RZBiz

RZBiz began in 2016, building its own identity and network while sourcing for major commodities companies in Brazil. Today, it provides strong access to raw materials for global industry, backed by a trusted network and reliable sourcing practices.

Materials

A curated range of raw materials, available through direct industry relationships.

Copper Ore

Grade: 10–25%

Copper ore is rock that contains enough copper to be mined and processed economically. It’s crushed and milled, then concentrated before smelting and refining into usable copper, like cathodes — mainly for electrical wiring, electronics, construction, motors, and renewable tech like solar panels and wind turbines.

Copper Concentrate

Grade: 25–32%

Available through direct industry relationships.

Tungsten Ore Concentrate

Grade: 30–70%

Tungsten is used where you need extreme hardness or heat resistance — cutting tools, drill bits, wear-resistant parts, and heavy-duty industrial applications. It also shows up in lighting and electronics, thanks to having one of the highest melting points of any metal.

Tin Ore

Grade: 65%

Tin ore is mainly refined into tin metal, vital for solder in electronics. It’s also used in tin plating to prevent corrosion, in alloys like bronze, and in tin-plated steel for food cans — big in electronics, packaging, and metal alloys.
